}

list_types = {
    "List<Prop>", "List<Stat>", "List<Layer>", "List<Group>", "List<AuthorId>", "List<ConceptId>", "List<Attribute>"
}

def get_abbrev(name):
    # uppercase letters if multiple
    caps = ''.join(c for c in name if c.isupper())
    if len(caps) > 1: return caps
    return name[:2]

components_to_update = {}

comp_pattern = re.compile(r"(public class (\w+Component) : DiffComponent<(\w+Param),\s*(\w+Goo),\s*(\w+)>[^\{]*\{)([^}]*)\}", re.MULTILINE)
for match in comp_pattern.finditer(gh_cs):
    full_decl = match.group(1)
    comp_name = match.group(2)
    model_name = match.group(5)
    body = match.group(6)
    
    if model_name in diff_models and len(diff_models[model_name]) > 0:
        props = diff_models[model_name]
        
        # We need to implement RegisterModelInputParams, RegisterModelOutputParams, GetModelData, SetModelData
        
        input_params = []
        output_params = []
        get_data = []
        set_data = []
        
        get_data_vars = []
        
        for i, (prop_type, prop_name) in enumerate(props):
            param_type = type_to_gh_param.get(prop_type, prop_type)
            is_list = prop_type in list_types
            gh_access = "GH_ParamAccess.list" if is_list else "GH_ParamAccess.item"
            abbrev = get_abbrev(prop_name)
            if not is_list: abbrev += "?"
            else: abbrev += "*"
            
            if param_type in ["Text", "Boolean", "Number", "Integer", "Time"]:
                param_add = f'pManager.Add{param_type}Parameter("{prop_name}", "{abbrev}", "The optional {prop_name.lower()}.", {gh_access});'
                
                # Get data logic
                default_val = '""' if param_type == "Text" else 'false' if param_type == "Boolean" else '0' if param_type in ["Number", "Integer"] else 'default'
                camel_name = prop_name[:1].lower() + prop_name[1:]
                
                if param_type == "Text":
                    get_data_vars.append(f'string {camel_name} = null;')
                elif param_type == "Boolean":
                    get_data_vars.append(f'bool? {camel_name} = null;')
                elif param_type == "Time":
                    get_data_vars.append(f'DateTime? {camel_name} = null;')
                elif param_type in ["Number", "Integer"]:
                    get_data_vars.append(f'double? {camel_name} = null;')
                    
                idx = i + 2 # +2 because DiffComponent inherits from PassthroughComponent which adds ModelName and Validate
                
                if param_type == "Text":
                    get_data.append(f'var {camel_name}Str = "";')
                    get_data.append(f'if (DA.GetData({idx}, ref {camel_name}Str)) model.{prop_name} = {camel_name}Str;')
                else:
                    var_type = "bool" if param_type == "Boolean" else "DateTime" if param_type == "Time" else "double"
                    get_data.append(f'{var_type} {camel_name}Val = default;')
                    get_data.append(f'if (DA.GetData({idx}, ref {camel_name}Val)) model.{prop_name} = {camel_name}Val;')
                
                set_data.append(f'if (model.ShouldSerialize{prop_name}()) DA.SetData({idx}, model.{prop_name});')
                
            else:
                param_add = f'pManager.AddParameter(new {param_type}Param(), "{prop_name}", "{abbrev}", "The optional {prop_name.lower()}.", {gh_access});'
                camel_name = prop_name[:1].lower() + prop_name[1:]
                idx = i + 2
                
                if is_list:
                    get_data.append(f'var {camel_name} = new List<{param_type}Goo>();')
                    get_data.append(f'if (DA.GetDataList({idx}, {camel_name})) model.{prop_name} = {camel_name}.Select(x => x.Value.DeepClone()).ToList();')
                    set_data.append(f'if (model.ShouldSerialize{prop_name}() && model.{prop_name} is not null) DA.SetDataList({idx}, model.{prop_name}.Select(x => new {param_type}Goo(x.DeepClone())).ToList());')
                else:
                    get_data.append(f'var {camel_name} = new {param_type}Goo();')
                    get_data.append(f'if (DA.GetData({idx}, ref {camel_name})) model.{prop_name} = {camel_name}.Value.DeepClone();')
                    set_data.append(f'if (model.ShouldSerialize{prop_name}() && model.{prop_name} is not null) DA.SetData({idx}, new {param_type}Goo(model.{prop_name}.DeepClone()));')
            
            input_params.append(f'        {param_add}')
            output_params.append(f'        {param_add}')
            
        components_to_update[comp_name] = {
            "decl": full_decl,
            "body": body,
            "input": "\n".join(input_params),
            "output": "\n".join(output_params),
            "get_data": "\n        ".join(get_data),
            "set_data": "\n        ".join(set_data)
        }

print(f"Components to update: {list(components_to_update.keys())}")
if 'DesignDiffComponent' in components_to_update:
    print("\n--- DesignDiffComponent ---")
    print("Input:")
    print(components_to_update['DesignDiffComponent']['input'])
    print("\nGet:")
    print(components_to_update['DesignDiffComponent']['get_data'])
